Gate now requires applicationStatus = 'Applied' for the pre-progressed AppProgress → force-InterviewStatus-N/A rule (Skipped / referral paths are exempt since they bypass formal applicationProgress). New cascade: when interviewStatus is N/A or terminal → interviewProgress forced to N/A. Auto-stamping for interviewProgressLastUpdate. Job Status upward gate updated to the new in-flight set.

Wiring complete: filters (tri-state filter chip support), JobForm (defaults to N/A, stripped from PATCH so the dedicated card owns it), AI parse + follow-up prompts (statusEnumsSection includes the new field with a note that it's gated to in-flight stages only), audit warnings (in-flight set matches new InterviewStatus enum), Settings custom-statuses editor (per-field row for InterviewProgress like the other 6 fields).

releases.title: Fix runtime crash on Voices job (string interviewResults snuck past v3 migration) + defensive hydrate guard

items.label: Voices Product Manager job detail page crashed with `(job.interviewResults ?? []).map is not a function` because its interviewResults was the string 'Strong Mutual Interest' (legacy single-value form) instead of the v3 array form. Either edited after the v3 migration ran or saved via a code path that bypassed Zod normalization. Re-ran scripts/migrate-to-v3.ts (idempotent + backup) — converted the lone bad row to ['Strong Mutual Interest']. Scanned the whole dataset: zero other jobs were affected.

hydrate() now defensively normalizes interviewResults to an array regardless of what shape it was stored in: array→array, string→[string] (unless 'N/A' or empty → []), anything else→[]. Catches future stale data from hand edits or any code path that bypasses the schema. Single boundary fix means every downstream consumer (JobHeader, InterviewResultCard, dashboard pills, contacts/streams pages) receives a guaranteed array without each having to defend itself.

releases.title: Communication card on job detail page: chain-grouped view (collapsible) instead of flat per-message panels

items.label: OutreachCard now groups messages into chains (channel + contact = one chain) — same rule as the /communication page. Each chain renders collapsed by default as one row with: channel pill, contact name, purpose label (if set on job.chains[]), draft-count chip if any pending, message count + last-activity date, and a who-initiated indicator (Send icon + 'You started' / Inbox icon + 'They started'). Click to expand; the messages render oldest→newest below with the existing per-message actions (Copy / Open in Mail / Mark sent). Drops the v3.2 flat 'every message is its own bordered panel' look that made job pages with 6+ messages noisy. Card title now shows 'N chains · M messages'.

Inside an expanded chain, individual messages skip the redundant channel pill in their header (the chain header already labels the channel) and drop the outer border (the chain row provides the box + dividers). Message bodies still hide by default; click 'Show body' on a specific message to read it.

releases.title: TOC active section: bottom-of-scroll override (Timeline now highlights when you Scroll to Bottom)

items.label: Hitting 'Bottom' kept Attachments highlighted instead of Timeline. Root cause: the active-section detector picked 'the last section whose top has scrolled past the 120px buffer'. Timeline is a short tail section — when you scroll all the way down, its TOP is still in the lower half of the viewport (not above the 120px line), so it never qualified. Added a bottom-of-scroll override: when the container has no more room to scroll, the active section snaps to the last existing section.

releases.title: Floating TOC scroll fix (correct container) + expand-with-labels mode + more positive Interview Result labels + denser InterviewResult card

items.label: Top / Bottom / Up one section / Down one section TOC buttons now work. Root cause: src/app/layout.tsx puts `overflow-hidden` on body and `overflow-y-auto` on <main>, so the actual scroll container is <main> — not window. The TOC was calling window.scrollTo and listening to window.scroll events, which silently no-op'd. Now resolves <main> on mount and acts on it directly. The section-jump buttons worked even before because scrollIntoView walks up to find the nearest scrollable ancestor automatically.

TOC can be expanded with a chevron toggle at the top. Collapsed = icons-only 28px-wide rail (default). Expanded = panel with each section's label next to its icon for quicker scanning. State stays during the session.

Five new positive Interview Result labels: 'Advanced to Next Round', 'Strong Technical Fit', 'Strong Cultural Fit', 'Compensation Aligned', 'Hiring Manager Champion'. Now 7 positive vs 8 negative — much closer to parity. Each renders with a green-family badge color (green / emerald / lime / teal / sky).

InterviewResult card restructured. The chip grid now spans the full card width (was squeezed into the left column of a 2-col grid). The 'Add labels as the process unfolds…' caption is now a full-width footnote below the chips so it doesn't word-wrap awkwardly. Last Update timestamp moved to a tiny corner of the header. Result: card is ~30% shorter and chips are tighter (px-1.5 + text-[10px] vs text-[11px]).

releases.title: Job detail page: floating side TOC + layout reshuffle (Resume|Cover, App|Progress, Status|Result pairs) + ApplicationCard trim + Interview Results pos/neg split

items.label: Floating side table-of-contents pinned to the right edge of the viewport on the job detail page (lg+ screens). Top/Bottom buttons jump to page extremes; Up/Down walk through the 7 sections (Priority & Status, Application, Interview Rounds, Communication, Contacts, Attachments, Timeline); each section icon jumps directly. Uses scroll listener + section <id> anchors with scroll-margin so the JobHeader doesn't cover the jumped-to section. Active section is highlighted as you scroll.

Detail page layout reshuffle. After Requirements & Responsibilities: Resume Used | Cover Letter Used (2-up). Then Application | Application Progress (2-up). Then Interview Status | Interview Result (2-up). Interview Rounds stays full-width below. Progressive cards still hide cleanly when their predicate is false — the un-paired card sits alone in the left column rather than orphaning.

ApplicationCard trimmed to 4 fields in a 2x2 grid: [Application Status | Role Open] / [Date Applied | Days Since]. Removed Contact (it lives on the Contacts card and the primaryContact is also editable from there). Removed Resume Created (moved to the Resume Used card as a header checkmark).

Resume Used card now surfaces 'Resume created' as a checkbox indicator in its header. Toggle persists via PATCH /api/jobs/:id with { resumeCreated }. Cover Letter card has no equivalent boolean and stays as before.

Interview Results multi-label chips now split into Positive (Interview Went Well / Strong Mutual Interest) on the left and Negative (Mixed Signals + 7 others) on the right. Two-column grid is denser — drops the card from ~5 rows of chips to ~2. Selected positive chips render emerald, negative chips render rose, so the overall lean of the round results reads at a glance. Custom user values from settings.customStatuses.interviewResults appear in a third 'Other' row.

releases.title: Contact phone formatting + Call button, contactType field (employee / external referrer / head hunter / personal connection), dedupe-by-name, fuzzy-find unattached fallback, Karl→Masterly anchor

items.label: Phone numbers auto-format as you type into the canonical NA shape '+1 (416) 555-0123 x123'. Extension parsing recognizes 'x', 'ext', ',' separators. International numbers (anything starting with '+' that isn't '+1') pass through unformatted. The formatter is idempotent so the input cursor stays stable. Used by both the EditContactDialog (Contacts page edit) and the inline ContactForm (job detail page Contacts card).

Click-to-call: a new 'Call' button next to each phone-number field and inline next to each phone display. Opens a tel: URL with the extension if present (RFC 3966 syntax: 'tel:+14165550123;ext=456'). On macOS the OS prompts to dial via FaceTime or your iPhone via Continuity.

Contact.contactType field (employee / external-referrer / head-hunter / personal-connection / other) added to the schema. Separate from `relationship` (which is the person's role w.r.t. you). Edit dialogs + add-contact forms expose a 'Relationship to company' dropdown. Contact-first view filters by this and shows a coloured badge on non-employee contacts (violet=referrer, fuchsia=head hunter, amber=personal). Employee contacts render badge-less (the common case).

Contact dedupe: case-insensitive normalized-name is now the merge key everywhere. Migration script merged the duplicate 'Howard Bisgould' entries on the Karl lead (and one stale dupe in an archived Karl job), preserving phone + email from the populated entry. The Contact-first view aggregates the SAME person across multiple jobs into one row regardless of email mismatches.

Karl Czarnecki lead's anchorCompany is now 'Masterly' (was null). Karl's contact is tagged 'external-referrer' (he's not a Masterly employee — his connection is the CEO). Howard Bisgould is tagged 'personal-connection'. Marc Roginsky on the Sierra.AI lead is tagged 'head-hunter'.

Fuzzy-match attach button now falls back to unattached PDFs when no company-name match is found. If the scan dir has resumes/cover letters that aren't yet attached to any job, they're listed (sorted by mtime) for manual selection. The UI distinguishes 'company-name matches' from 'unattached fallback' picks so it's clear what's inferred vs hand-chosen.

Migration script (scripts/migrate-to-v3_1.ts): idempotent + backup, ran cleanly. Merged 1 duplicate in jobs.json + 1 in leads.json, backfilled 38 'employee' contactType defaults across job contacts, set 3 lead contacts to their correct types, set Karl-lead anchorCompany to Masterly. Explicit guard against writing the user's own phone (4168946111) anywhere.

Lead contact API endpoint now defaults new contacts to 'external-referrer' instead of 'employee' (the common case for lead-shaped records). Job contact API still defaults to 'employee'. AI parse + follow-up prompts already know about the field via the v3.0 enum injection.

releases.title: Contacts: phone field surfaced in the edit + add forms (was already in the data model, but the UI didn't expose it)

items.label: Phone number field added to both contact edit/add surfaces: the EditContactDialog on the Contacts page (works for job-attached AND lead-attached contacts), and the inline ContactForm inside the job detail page's Contacts card. tel: link, free-text input, persists via PATCH /api/jobs/[id]/contacts and /api/leads/[id]/contacts. The underlying data model already supported phone (since v2.12) — this just unlocks the missing UI surface so you can edit it without dropping to jobs.json.
Phone number displays as a tel: link on each contact row in the Job detail Contacts card, next to email + LinkedIn. The leads detail page already surfaced it.

releases.title: User-extensible status enums + multi-label Interview Result + Job Status hard-gate + fuzzy-match PDF attach

items.label: Interview Result is now a MULTI-label array (matching per-round outcomeLabels). Add labels as the process unfolds — e.g. 'Interview Went Well' + 'Salary Too Low' — instead of forcing a single verdict. The field is always editable (no lock); the v2.26 'Mark interviewing complete' lock has been removed. JobHeader renders every label as its own pill. Two sentinel values dropped from the enum: 'In Progress' and 'Ended Prematurely' (they were a v2.26 workaround; the multi-array model needs neither).

Job Status is HARD-gated. The patchJob() upward gate rejects any write that sets Job Status to a non-N/A value while interviewStatus is in any in-flight state (In Progress / Awaiting Next Steps / Delayed / Final Round Scheduled / Awaiting Decision). When interviewStatus is N/A (no interview ever happened) or terminal (Completed / Ended Prematurely), Job Status is writable. JobStatusCard disables the dropdown + shows an explanatory caption when locked. Mirrors the user's mental model: Job Status only makes sense after the interview pipeline has resolved one way or another.

User-extensible status enums for all 6 status fields. New Settings page tab 'Custom Statuses' lets you add your own values for: Application Status, Application Progress, Interview Status, Interview Results, Job Status, and Initiated By. Pick a badge color from the 16-color palette per value. Customs appear in dropdowns alongside built-in values and render with the chosen color. Built-in values stay read-only (they're what the cascade and visibility rules pattern-match against). settings.customStatuses persists in settings.json.

AI prompts inject the live enum values. claudeCodeParsePrompt() and claudeCodeFollowUpPrompt() now take a Settings argument and emit an 'Allowed status enum values' section listing every value (built-in + custom) per field. So when you ask an AI chat to update a job's status, it can pick from the full user-extensible set.

Fuzzy-match PDF attach button on AttachmentsCard. Resume tab and Cover Letter tab each get a 'Find matching PDF' button. Scans ~/Documents/Work & Profession/Job Search/ (one level deep, excluding __archive/), scores PDF filenames by company-name match, classifies by 'resume' vs 'cover letter' filename pattern, and shows the top 5 candidates with mtime + score. Click 'Use this' to copy into data/attachments/<jobId>/ and patch the job. Reuses the same companyMatchScore heuristic as the original migration script.

Data model: Job's status fields (applicationStatus, applicationProgress, interviewStatus, jobStatus, initiatedBy) are now typed as `string` instead of strict union literals. Runtime validation switched from Zod z.enum() to z.string() with cross-check against built-in ∪ custom at write time. interviewResults is `string[]`. Existing data preserved; type narrowing for built-in values still works via string equality.

Migration scripts/migrate-to-v3.ts: converted 7 interviewResults string values into single-element arrays; dropped 84 sentinel values ('N/A' / 'In Progress' / 'Ended Prematurely') to empty arrays; snapped 5 jobs from interviewStatus='N/A' → 'Completed' where rounds existed and a job outcome was already set (those clearly had interviews that ended; the N/A was a legacy artefact). Idempotent + backup.

Audit warning surfaces pre-existing 'Job Status set while interviewing in-flight' inconsistencies, so data from before the v3.0 gate gets flagged for cleanup. Skips the legacy 'Interview Process Ended' jobStatus (compatible with any interviewStatus).

v3.0 cleanup: removed the v2.26 patchJob cascade that forced interviewResults to 'In Progress' on interviewStatus change. Removed the InterviewResultCard 'locked while interviewing' UI. Removed the v2.26.1 JobHeader pill suppression. JobForm no longer surfaces a single-value Interview Result dropdown — the InterviewResultsMultiSelect chip toggle on the detail page is the canonical surface. EditForm strips interviewResults from PATCH so editing other fields doesn't clobber the multi-select.

releases.title: Fix 'Invalid patch' on edit form — backfill legacy enum values + suppress stale result pill in header

items.label: Edit form was rejecting saves with 'Invalid patch' for 3 active jobs whose enum fields still carried legacy values from older schema versions. Migration script scripts/migrate-stale-enum-values.ts mapped them to current values: jobStatus 'Not Offered Job' → 'No Offer Made' (TTEC, TELUS), and on the Compass CDAI AI Engineering Manager row: applicationProgress 'Interview In Progress' → 'Interview Scheduled', interviewStatus 'Interview Set Up' → 'In Progress', jobStatus 'In Process' → 'N/A'. Took a backup, idempotent.

JobHeader no longer shows a quality interviewResults pill (e.g. 'Interview Went Well') while interviewing is still in-flight. The v2.26 gating treats the overall result as locked until you mark interviewing complete; the header now reflects that. Sentinel values ('In Progress' / 'Ended Prematurely') still render so the in-flight state stays visible.

releases.title: Sticky JobHeader, Priority strip + Core/Fit pair layout, per-round multi-label outcomes, Interview Result gating

items.label: JobHeader now condenses to a thin sticky bar when you scroll past it on a job detail page. Full header (logo + title + company + action buttons + status pills + pipeline label) stays at the top; once it scrolls out of view, a compact bar pins to the top with just the essentials (small logo, title, company, Log comm / Replace logo / Edit / Dashboard buttons). Driven by an IntersectionObserver on a sentinel below the full header.

Detail-page layout reshuffle. Priority & Status is now a full-width thin strip (Priority / Active state / Initiated by laid out horizontally in 3 columns), with Core Info and Fit Analysis as a side-by-side pair directly below it. Fixes the previous gap where nothing sat next to Fit Analysis. Everything below (Requirements, Application, Resume, Interview, Attachments, Notes, Timeline) stays in its current grid position.

Per-round outcome labels are now MULTI-SELECT. Each interview round has a chip-toggle group (Strong Mutual Interest / Interview Went Well / Mixed Signals / Cultural Fit Concerns / Salary Too Low / Not a Good Fit / Not Technical Enough / Too Senior for Role / Too Junior for Role / Interview Went Poorly) — pick as many as fit. Mixed-signal rounds (e.g. 'Went Well' + 'Salary Too Low') no longer need to be forced into a single label.

Data model: InterviewRound.outcomeLabel (singular) → outcomeLabels (string array). Migration script scripts/migrate-round-outcome-labels-to-array.ts moved 30 existing rounds: 19 had a label (carried into a single-element array), 11 had null (became empty array). Backup taken; idempotent.

Interview Status: 'Mark interviewing complete' toggle button now lives in the InterviewStatusCard header. Click it to flip status to 'Completed' (the toggle becomes 'Reopen interviewing' if you need to back out). When status is in an in-flight state (In Progress / Awaiting Next Steps / Delayed / Final Round Scheduled / Awaiting Decision), the card shows a 'Round N' counter chip next to the status pill so you can see at a glance which round you're in.

Interview Result is now gated. Two new sentinel values added to the InterviewResults enum: 'In Progress' (rendered while interviewing is active) and 'Ended Prematurely' (auto-set when the matching status flips). The job-level result is locked to one of those sentinels until you mark interviewing complete; only then does the dropdown unlock and let you pick a final quality label. The patchJob() cascade in jobs-repo.ts keeps interviewResults in sync with interviewStatus automatically.

Dashboard Interview column gains a compact 'R{N}' inline counter chip right next to the status pill while interviewing is in-flight. The existing 'Round N/M · Hiring Manager — scheduled' subline below the pill stays as the more detailed indicator.
Data fix: one stale interviewResults value ('Round 1 Passed — Moving to Round 2' on the Voiceflow Head of SE row) that was outside the enum is now 'In Progress' to match the new model.

releases.title: Electric Mind company logo + LinkedIn source logo fixes

items.label: Electric Mind company logo wasn't rendering. Root cause: yesterday's backfill set companyLogoPath='logo.jpeg' (bare filename), which fell through the resolver to '/logo.jpeg' and 404'd. The 72 other jobs all use the full 'data/attachments/<jobId>/logo.jpeg' format. Corrected the field — the avatar now resolves through /api/files/<jobId>/logo.jpeg as designed.

Source column logos (LinkedIn, etc.) were missing. Root cause: Clearbit's logo API silently 404s for linkedin.com (returns an empty body with no headers), and SourceCell hid the on error with no fallback. Added a Google-favicons fallback to sourcePlatformLogoResolution() and made SourceCell try the fallback before giving up. Mirrors the same primary→fallback pattern CompanyAvatar already uses for company logos.

releases.title: Dashboard default sort → Activity (covers Found / Applied / Outreach / Interview / Skipped uniformly)

items.label: Dashboard now defaults to sorting by Activity (ascending) instead of Applied date (descending). Activity already exists as a column and encodes the full picture: upcoming scheduled events (interview in 3 days) come first as negative days, then recent past activity (outreach yesterday, applied 2 days ago, skip-then-recruiter-chat last week), then older activity. Jobs with zero activity at all sink to the bottom.

Why this is better than dateApplied: 'Not Applied' and 'Skipped' rows used to pin to the top with a blank value, ahead of real applications. An older application that progressed to interviews used to rank below a newer un-progressed application. With activity sort, a skipped role where you're now actively chatting with the recruiter / working team surfaces above stale never-progressed applications, which matches where your attention should actually go.
Activity is still shown in its own column, so the sort order is legible at a glance. Click any column header to override (Applied date sorting is one click away on the 'Applied' column).

releases.title: Communication filters (lead/job, active state, stale) + lead kind icon fallback + Electric Mind logo backfill

items.label: Communication page gains filter chips at the top: Kind (All / Jobs / Leads), Active state (Active / Inactive / Both — defaults to Active), and a 'Stale only' toggle. Stale uses the same isStale rule as the dashboard for jobs, and the lead staleness rule (no activity for 14 days, active/dormant only) for leads. Header now reports 'N of M shown' as you filter.

CompanyAvatar accepts an optional fallbackIcon prop. When a lead has no anchorCompany (and the favicon / logo paths return nothing), the avatar slot renders the lead's kind icon (Users for warm-referral, Search for head-hunter, etc.) instead of a generic '?' placeholder. Threaded through ContactsStreams (all 3 view modes + appearances) and CommunicationStreams.

Electric Mind logo was missing on Communication and Contacts pages because companyLogoPath was null while logo.jpeg existed on disk. Backfilled the field; the avatar now resolves through the standard /api/files/<jobId>/logo.jpeg path.

releases.title: Leads expanded — detail page, stale tracking, cross-page integration (Contacts + Communication), promoted-from-lead history on Jobs

items.label: New /leads/[id] detail page: sticky header with company avatar / kind icon + headline + status pill + stale indicator, then cards for Lead facts (kind + anchors, editable inline), Contacts (full info per contact), Outreach history (sorted newest-first with channel icons), Notes (edit inline), and Status (change status with optional reason, plus a conversion callout linking to the spawned job when status=converted). Less expansive than the Job detail page on purpose — leads don't have application/interview/offer cards.

LeadOriginCard on /jobs/[id]: when a job was promoted from a lead, a 'Lead origin' card renders right under the JobHeader showing the source lead's headline (linked), kind, anchors, dates, and contact/outreach counts (plus collapsible pre-promotion notes). Driven by the new bidirectional `job.promotedFromLeadId` field paired with `lead.convertedToJobId`. Falls back gracefully if the referenced lead was deleted.

Lead staleness: leads can now go stale if they sit too long without activity (default threshold = 14 days from last outreach or status change). The /leads page has a 'Stale only' toggle and stale leads render with an amber border + warning badge. Only active/dormant leads check stale; abandoned and converted are skipped.

Contacts page now includes lead contacts: each lead becomes a 'company row' (grouped by anchorCompany or its headline if unanchored) with a sprout 'Lead' pill instead of the application/interview status pills. Right-pane header → 'Open lead →' links to /leads/[id]. EditContactDialog takes a kind discriminator so PATCHes route to /api/leads/[id]/contacts vs /api/jobs/[id]/contacts.

Communication page now includes lead chains: leads with logged outreach appear alongside jobs in the left pane (sprout Lead pill next to the company name). Chain headers render a Lead pill next to the contact name and the 'Open job →' link becomes 'Open lead →' pointing at /leads/[id]. The page subtitle reports jobs + leads separately.
anchorCompanyUrl added to the New Lead dialog so the company favicon / logo resolves on the lead card and detail page right away (previously you had to edit the lead after creation to get a logo).

Migration script (scripts/migrate-lead-shaped-jobs-to-leads.ts): two existing jobs that were really leads in disguise (Sierra.AI head-hunter conversation, Karl Czarnecki referral) moved to data/leads.json with contacts + outreach preserved (canonical contact ids kept). Originals soft-archived in jobs.json so they no longer clutter the main dashboard. Three placeholder leads created earlier during scaffolding were deleted to avoid duplicates. Net: 72 active jobs, 2 active leads after migration.

releases.title: Leads — pre-job conversation threads with their own page + promote-to-job action

items.label: New Lead entity stored in data/leads.json (separate from jobs.json — fitScore / dateApplied / applicationStatus don't apply to leads, so a separate type keeps the Job schema clean). Fields: headline, kind (head-hunter / warm-referral / old-lead-reconnect / exploratory-discussion / company-pre-application / other), optional anchors (anchorPerson, anchorCompany, anchorCompanyUrl, anchorRoleType), status (active / dormant / converted / abandoned), convertedToJobId, statusReason, plus the standard contacts / outreach / chains / notes / tags from the Job shape.

New top-level /leads page with sidebar entry (Leads, sprout icon, between Pipeline and Contacts). Card-grid layout with filters across the top (status, kind, free-text search). Each card shows headline, kind icon, anchor info, contact + outreach counts, status pill, and inline action buttons.

Promote-to-job flow: click 'Promote to job' on a lead → dialog pre-fills title/company/companyUrl from the lead's anchors → spawns a new Job with the lead's contacts copied (canonical ids preserved), tags ['promoted-from-lead'], source set to 'Head hunter' or 'Referral' based on lead kind, initiatedBy='recruiter' for head-hunter leads. The lead's status flips to 'converted' with convertedToJobId pointing at the new job. Lead's outreach stays on the lead by default (opt-in checkbox to copy).
Lead lifecycle actions on each card: Mark dormant (quiet but keep), Abandon (with optional reason prompt), Re-activate, Re-open. Status-specific buttons hide/show based on current state.

Five new API endpoints: GET/POST /api/leads · GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/leads/[id] · POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/leads/[id]/outreach · POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/leads/[id]/contacts · POST /api/leads/[id]/promote. Mirrors the Job API shape so existing client components (EditContactDialog, CommunicationComposerDialog) can target either kind with minimal changes.

leads-repo.ts mirrors jobs-repo.ts pattern (mutex-guarded read/write, atomic tmp+rename, ensureFile on first read so data/leads.json auto-creates). Simpler than jobs-repo though — no auto-timeline or *LastUpdate stamping since leads don't have status enums beyond their single 'status' field.

releases.title: Terminal interview states (Completed / Ended Prematurely), better job-status labels, tri-state filter chips

items.label: Interview Status: added 'Completed' (process ran to its natural end — all expected rounds happened) and 'Ended Prematurely' (process stopped mid-way — they stopped responding, you withdrew, or they ended it early). Job Status carries the outcome from there (Offered / No Offer / Went with Another Candidate / etc.).

Job Status: renamed 'Not Offered Job' → 'No Offer Made' (clearer phrasing). Added 'Went with Another Candidate' for the specific case where the company tells you they hired someone else. Migration script (scripts/migrate-rename-not-offered-job.ts) renamed 7 existing jobs in jobs.json with a timestamped backup taken first.

Tri-state filter chips: clicking a status chip on the dashboard now cycles through three states — unselected → INCLUDE (only show matching) → EXCLUDE (hide matching, show everything else) → unselected. URL encoding uses a !-prefix on excluded values (e.g. ?applicationStatus=Applied&applicationStatus=!Withdrew+Application). Multi-select still works; includes and excludes can mix freely.

Distinct visual treatment per state: INCLUDE = filled pill with primary ring (existing look). EXCLUDE = dashed rose ring + strikethrough + leading `−` icon, so the negation reads at a glance and doesn't rely on color alone. Hover tooltip on every chip tells you what the next click will do.

Server-side filter logic (lib/filters.ts) rewritten around a TriStateFilter shape (include[] + exclude[]). A job passes a filter when its value IS in include[] (if non-empty) AND is NOT in exclude[] (if non-empty). Applies to applicationStatus, applicationProgress, interviewStatus, jobStatus, priority, activeState, inactiveReason, initiatedBy.

hydrate.ts pipelineStage and audit rules updated to recognize the new terminal states. Jobs with interviewStatus='Ended Prematurely' OR jobStatus in {No Offer Made, Went with Another Candidate, Withdrew from Process, Interview Process Ended} all map to pipelineStage='Closed'.

releases.title: Interview rounds capture meeting method — phone / video / in-person — with actionable handle

items.label: Add/Edit Round dialog now has a Meeting method picker (Phone call / Video call / In person / not specified). Selecting one reveals exactly one handle field below it: phone number, video conferencing URL, or free-text location. Switching method keeps the form tidy — only the relevant handle is persisted.

Round cards now show a meeting badge under the scheduled-at line: phone icon + tel: link for phone rounds, video icon + 'Join call' deep-link for video rounds, map-pin icon + location text for in-person rounds. Rounds without a method set render nothing, so older data is unaffected.

Data model: InterviewRound gains `meetingMethod`, `meetingPhone`, `meetingVideoUrl`, `meetingLocation`. All optional + nullable so pre-v2.22 rounds validate without migration. The POST /rounds API forwards all four fields; PATCH already merged unknown keys.

releases.title: Communication chains: per-chain purpose + channel icons + three-author bubbles

items.label: Chain list now shows a channel icon (Email / LinkedIn / Phone / SMS / In-person) and a purpose icon + label per chain. Purpose values: Company-initiated, Self-initiated, Application follow-up, Lead follow-up, Other. Chain-level metadata persists on `job.chains[]`.

Each message now carries an explicit `from: 'me' | 'company' | 'system'` field. The thread renders three distinct bubble colors so author is obvious at a glance — blue for you, neutral for the company contact, amber for system/automated messages.
Chain header surfaces the channel-appropriate contact handle: email link for Email chains, LinkedIn profile URL for LinkedIn chains, phone number for SMS / phone chains.

Migration to v2.21: multi-turn dialogues previously embedded in a single `body` blob (Electric Mind, Mosaic scheduling threads) split into discrete messages. Voiceflow's legacy `at/direction/from/summary` shape normalized to the modern OutreachMessage shape. Legacy records gained `toContactId` so all messages with the same person collapse into one chain.
Job list shows chain count (not raw message count) per job. The page header summary line reports messages, chains, and jobs separately.

releases.title: Paste markdown directly into the Job Description tab — View / Edit toggle

items.label: Job Description tab now has an inline markdown editor. Click 'Paste markdown' (when no JD exists) or 'Edit raw markdown' / 'Write markdown instead' (when one does) to open a 480px textarea. Save converts the text to a synthesized File and writes it via the existing /attachments POST endpoint as job-description.md — no separate API path needed.

Two-mode flow: 'View' shows the rendered markdown (headers / bullets / bold / tables / blockquotes). 'Edit' shows the raw textarea. Switching to edit auto-loads the existing .md content so you can revise rather than rewrite from scratch.

Edit mode shows a live character count + 'saves as job-description.md' hint. Save button is disabled until there's actual content. Pre-existing PDF JDs offer a 'Write markdown instead' button so you can switch formats without leaving the tab.

releases.title: Job Description supports markdown — upload .md or .pdf, in-browser formatted rendering

items.label: Job Description tab on the job detail page now accepts both PDF and Markdown (.md / .markdown) files. PDFs continue to embed via iframe as before; markdown files render in-browser with formatted headers, bullet lists, bold/italic, links, tables, blockquotes, code blocks — everything GitHub-flavored markdown supports (powered by react-markdown + remark-gfm).

Storage: saveAttachment for job-description now keeps the source extension (.pdf or .md). Uploading a .md after an existing .pdf (or vice versa) cleans up the old variant so the stored documents.jobDescriptionPdfPath always points to the active file.
File-serving route now returns text/markdown content-type for .md / .markdown so the client fetch() interprets it correctly.
Markdown viewer styling tuned for both light + dark mode (h1-h4 sizes, list spacing, code blocks, tables with borders, blockquote pull-quote) without adding @tailwindcss/typography as a dependency.

releases.title: Contact-first view shows company logo next to each contact + each appearance

items.label: Contact-first view in /contacts now shows the company logo next to each contact in the left list (uses the first appearance's logo). Threaded companyUrl + companyLogoPath through the aggregation so the appearance items carry their company's branding.
Right pane 'Appears on' list now shows a 20px company logo next to each job appearance so you can spot the right role visually instead of by company name alone.

releases.title: Dashboard Salary column wraps long values instead of pushing the table wider

items.label: Salary cell on the dashboard table dropped its whitespace-nowrap and added max-w-[14rem] + break-words. Long values like 'Not Listed (estimated $137,600 – $187,600 CAD based on another PwC role)' now wrap onto multiple lines inside the cell instead of forcing the whole table to scroll horizontally.

releases.title: Company logo fills its square again — Tailwind preflight max-width was clamping it

items.label: Real root cause of the vertical-pill logos: Tailwind's preflight global `img { max-width: 100% }` was clamping the avatar width to whatever narrow space the table column had (after Progress / Activity / Found columns were added in v2.9 / v2.12, the dashboard went from 12 → 14 columns and the logo column shrank). The img's width attribute got overridden, height stayed at 32px, so a square logo source rendered as a 12×32 vertical strip. Fixed by adding `max-w-none` + inline `min-width` / `min-height` on the avatar img.

releases.title: Company logos fill the rounded square again (object-contain → object-cover)

items.label: CompanyAvatar's switched from object-contain to object-cover. Earlier behavior was letterboxing non-square logos into a vertical pill with gray sidebars on either side. With object-cover, the logo fills the rounded square (with a tiny edge crop on the longer dimension), which matches how the avatars used to look. Applies everywhere CompanyAvatar is used — dashboard, contacts, communication, job header, audit, outreach.

releases.title: Dashboard logo size bumped 24 → 32 so company icons read naturally again

items.label: Dashboard's company avatar bumped from the CompanyAvatar default of 24px to an explicit 32px. The earlier visual you remembered had the avatars at 32px; the dashboard was implicitly falling back to the 24px default which made logos look tiny / faint. Matches the visual weight of the row text + status pills. Other surfaces (Audit, Outreach, Contacts streams) stay at their existing sizes.

releases.title: Job-first sort: jobs with no contacts now sort to the bottom within each active/inactive band

items.label: Job-first view in /contacts now uses a four-tier sort: (1) Active + has contacts, (2) Active + no contacts, (3) Inactive + has contacts, (4) Inactive + no contacts. Within each tier still sorts by most-recent comm, then alphabetical. Mirrors the Company-first behavior where no-contact companies sort to the bottom.

releases.title: Contacts: inactive filter fix, smarter defaults, 3rd view (Job-first 2-pane), prominent inactive banner

items.label: Bugfix: 'Hide all-inactive companies' was checking applicationStatus when it should have been checking activeState — so jobs you withdrew from (e.g. Rogers Product Owner — withdrew but still applicationStatus=Applied) didn't get filtered out. Now uses the canonical activeState=Inactive signal. Filter renamed to 'Hide companies with no active roles' to match what it actually does.

Defaults adjusted on the Contacts page: 'Hide companies with no active roles' is now ON by default (the common case is focusing on current pursuits). 'Hide companies with no contacts' is OFF by default — instead, those companies sort to the bottom of the list (so they're still visible but de-emphasized). Sort order: active+contacts → active+empty → inactive (all sub-sorted by recent comm + alphabetical).
Renamed: the original 'Job-first' view is now called 'Company-first' (which is what it actually is — the left column is companies). 'Contact-first' unchanged.

New 3rd view: 'Job-first' — flat 2-pane list of jobs (with company logo + name + status pills inline) on the left, contacts for the selected job on the right. For when you want to scan all roles directly without going through company grouping first. Inactive jobs render with muted opacity + an 'Inactive · reason' tag.

Prominent 'Inactive opportunity' banner at the top of every inactive job's detail page. Replaces the easy-to-miss small pill with a full-width strip that includes the inactive reason (Withdrew / Ghosted / Rejected / etc.) so the state is unambiguous the moment you land on the page.

releases.title: Settings → Companies: 'Unaliased company names' panel surfaces gaps

items.label: Confirmed that Contacts (and Communication / Pipeline / Dashboard) already groups by company aliases — that's been the behavior since v2.14. PwC + PwC Canada collapse to one entry; aliased Compass variants collapse to one entry.

New 'Unaliased company names' panel in Settings → Company Aliases. Lists every raw company string in jobs.json that isn't already a canonical or an alias. For each name, a dropdown lets you 'Attach to…' an existing group with one click, or 'New group with this name' to start fresh. Closes the gap when the auto-suggester misses variants that share no obvious tokens (e.g., 'CDAI (Compass Digital)' wasn't bucketed with 'Compass Group (CDAI — ...)' because the reduced forms differ).

releases.title: Template assets resolve to PDF + Canva on jobs; Contacts filters + Contact-first view

items.label: Fixed: picking a resume / cover letter template on a job didn't surface the configured PDF Path or Canva URL anywhere. Now the ResumeChoiceCard shows a 'Resolved from Settings' box with the actual PDF path + Canva link the moment you pick a template; warns when the template asset isn't configured yet.

Fixed: AttachmentsCard's Resume + Cover Letter tabs were empty for jobs that used templates instead of per-job uploads. Now the tabs fall back to the template asset from Settings → Resume / Cover Letters (PDF embeds inline, Canva URL clickable). A small amber strip explains it's the template asset and uploading here will replace it just for this job. Per-job uploads always take precedence over the template fallback.
New API route: /api/files/template/[...filename] serves files from data/templates/ (path-traversal protected). Powers the inline PDF iframe for template-resolved resumes / cover letters.

Contacts page: two new toggle filters at the top — 'Hide companies with no contacts' (skip companies you haven't built a contact on yet) and 'Hide all-inactive companies' (hide companies whose every job is in a terminal-no-pursue state: Withdrew / Not Looking / Missed Window / On Hold).

Contacts page: new view-mode toggle 'Job-first' vs 'Contact-first'. Job-first is the existing three-pane (companies → jobs → contacts). Contact-first flattens to a deduplicated person list — click a contact to see every job they appear on, with status pills and a jump-to-job link. Useful when you remember the person but not the role.

releases.title: Company aliases — collapse variant company names into one canonical

items.label: New Settings tab: Company Aliases. Curate groups where multiple raw company strings collapse to a single canonical name everywhere they're grouped (Contacts, Communication, Dashboard, Pipeline). Examples: 'PwC' + 'PwC Canada' → all show as 'PwC'; the three Compass Group CDAI variants → 'CDAI (Compass Digital)'.

Display-only normalization: raw `job.company` values in jobs.json are NEVER rewritten. The Contacts streams group by canonical, the Communication streams + Pipeline + Dashboard show the canonical, but the underlying data is preserved so you can re-categorize at any time without data loss.

Auto-detected suggestions: the Settings page scans your jobs.json for company strings that share a parenthetical or corporate-suffix-reduced form (e.g. all three Compass Group CDAI variants bucket together). One-click 'Add as group' creates the alias group with the shortest variant as the suggested canonical — you can rename + edit.

Dashboard 'Company' cell shows the canonical as primary text with the original variant as a small italic subtitle. Sort-by-Company now sorts by the canonical so all PwC roles cluster regardless of variant.
Validation: same alias can't appear under two different canonicals; canonical names must be unique (case-insensitive); self-aliases are ignored. Errors surface inline in the Settings UI before save.

releases.title: Contacts page rebuilt as three-pane streams (companies → jobs → contacts)

items.label: Contacts page rebuilt with the same drill-in pattern as the Communication page: companies (left) → jobs at that company (middle) → contacts for that job (right). If you've applied to 2+ roles at the same company (e.g. both Compass Group CDAI roles), they stack under one company entry — pick which role's contacts to see.

Contacts pane shows the full info card: name + primary/relationship pills, role, email/phone/LinkedIn links, 'Represents' company (for agency recruiters), 'How we connected' origin, notes, plus a compact comms history (last 5 messages with channel + subject + timestamp). Edit + Compose buttons on every contact.

Jobs pane shows status pills compactly — Application Status + Application Progress + Interview Status — so you can see at a glance whether each role is active or in progress without leaving the Contacts page.

Sticky headers everywhere on the Contacts page: page title stays pinned, plus each of the three panes has its own internal sticky strip (company search bar / 'Jobs · X' label / 'Company — Job' breadcrumb) so scrolling within a pane never loses context.

releases.title: Pre-interview vs interview split (applicationProgress), three-pane Communication streams

items.label: Structural split: new applicationProgress field (9 values) sits between applicationStatus and interviewStatus. Captures THEIR response to your application — Awaiting Response, Auto-acknowledged, Application Received, Application Under Review, Recruiter Reached Out, Interview Requested, Interview Scheduled, Application Rejected. Distinct from interviewStatus which now ONLY covers the actual interview process.

interviewStatus shrunk to 6 values: N/A, In Progress, Awaiting Next Steps, Delayed (new), Final Round Scheduled, Awaiting Decision. 'Interview Set Up' was renamed 'Interview Scheduled' and moved to applicationProgress. 'Interview In Progress' renamed 'In Progress'.
One-shot migration (scripts/migrate-to-v2_12.ts) split all 57 existing jobs cleanly. Idempotent + backup taken at data/jobs.pre-v2_12-*.bak.json.
Dashboard: new 'Progress' column between App and Interview. Sortable. Distinct badge colors for the 9 applicationProgress values. Filter chips bar gets a new 'Application Progress' row.
Detail page: new ApplicationProgressCard shown before InterviewStatusCard. Both editable inline via StatusPillSelect.

Communication page rebuilt as three-pane drill-in: jobs (left) → chains for selected job (middle) → conversation thread (right). A 'chain' = continuous exchange with one person on one channel. Messages within a chain sort oldest→newest so the conversation reads in flow. 'From you' messages get a subtle blue tint vs 'from them'. Replaces the flat all-jobs list.

Storage rules updated: auto-N/A rule now cascades through both fields (when applicationStatus is non-active, BOTH applicationProgress AND interviewStatus → N/A). New cascade: applicationProgress in any pre-interview state (Awaiting Response, Application Received, Auto-acknowledged, Recruiter Reached Out, Application Under Review, Interview Requested) or Application Rejected → interviewStatus = N/A. applicationProgressLastUpdate auto-stamped on change.

Audit rules + Pipeline funnel + QuickStats + staleness + InterviewRoundsCard all route pre-interview checks to applicationProgress and interview-process checks to interviewStatus, so the two fields don't bleed into each other.

releases.title: Backlog cleared: logo fixes, per-round results, sticky layout, Date Found column, contacts editing, Communication composer

items.label: Bugfix: uploaded company logos were disappearing on the Communication, Contacts, and Audit pages. Root cause was three CompanyAvatar call sites omitting the jobId prop, so the resolver fell through to a non-served '/data/attachments/...' URL. Fixed by plumbing jobId everywhere and making companyLogoUrl extract jobId from the path itself as a self-healing fallback. Logos now render consistently across every page.
Logo upload action on the full job detail page header — 'Set logo' / 'Replace logo' button next to Edit / Dashboard. Parity with the dashboard expanded-row upload; opens the same LogoUploadModal.

Per-round Interview Results — new outcomeLabel (mirrors the job-level InterviewResults enum: Not Technical Enough / Cultural Fit Concerns / Strong Mutual Interest / etc.) and outcomeNotes (free-text 'why') on every InterviewRound. Visible on each round card after completion. Pre-screen result can still be inferred from 'next round exists', but the explicit per-round label means reasons are never lost.

Sticky layout — sidebar pinned (never scrolls away), main content area scrolls independently, every page's title bar stays frozen at the top as the body scrolls underneath. backdrop-blur + border-bottom keeps the pinned header visually distinct from sliding content.
Sortable 'Found' column on the dashboard — the date the role first hit your radar (dateFound). Distinct from 'Applied' which captures when you actually submitted. Sort either independently.

Contacts page editing — every contact row gets an 'Edit' button that opens a full edit modal. Adds two new schema fields: howConnected (free-text origin like 'Recruiter outreach via LinkedIn' / 'Internal referral from John' / 'Met at conference') and representsCompany (for agency / staffing recruiters whose employer differs from the company they're sourcing FOR). Both surface on the row's expanded view.

Communication composer — log any communication tied to a specific job from anywhere in the app. Sidebar Quick Action ('Log comm') + job-scoped trigger on every detail-page header (opens with that job pre-selected). Job picker with typeahead, channel (LinkedIn / Email / Phone / Text / In-person / Other), purpose (cold-outreach / post-application / post-round / stale-pipeline / re-engagement / negotiation / thank-you / scheduling / other), contact picker (pre-populated from job's contacts[] with free-text fallback), subject + body, sent vs draft. Writes schema-shape outreach entries that show up on the Communication page, Contacts page, and the dashboard Activity column.

releases.title: Smart Activity column, auto-N/A interview rule, comms logged for Mosaic + Electric Mind

items.label: Dashboard 'Days' column → renamed to 'Activity', semantics rebuilt. Now shows the most useful signal: how long since real movement on the opportunity, OR how long until the next scheduled event (whichever is more relevant). Examples: 'in 2d · Pre-screen', '1d · HM interview done', '9d · App received', '29d quiet'. Color-coded by recency. Sort uses the new activityRank (negative=future, smaller=fresher). Tooltip shows full picture (Applied date, Found date, lifespan, last activity, next scheduled).

Sources counted as 'activity': dateApplied, outreach (sent + received), rounds (scheduled + completed), and qualifying timeline events (interview-status-change, auto-confirmation-received, under-review-notice, recruiter-reached-out, take-home-assigned, feedback-received, etc.). Future scheduled rounds override the backward-looking view. Falls back to dateFound for jobs not yet applied.

Staleness rule rebuilt — isStale now uses activity recency, not 'today − dateApplied'. Upcoming scheduled rounds suppress the stale flag entirely (you know movement is imminent). Threshold settings (settings.staleThresholdAppliedDays / staleThresholdInterviewingDays) still apply.

Auto-rule on save: applicationStatus in {Not Applied, Saved for Later, Drafting Application, Pending Referral, On Hold, Not Looking To Apply, Withdrew Application, Missed Application Window} forces interviewStatus = N/A. The implicit transition is captured in the timeline so you can see it happened. Reviewing, Applied, Skipped, and Role No Longer Open are unaffected.

Logged the two comm threads from chat: Mosaic Director of SE (Marianne Iannaci, 2 outreach entries — her Tuesday LinkedIn pitch + today's scheduling that landed on Fri May 15 12pm phone call). Electric Mind AI-Enabled SWE (Nathalie Cronick + Audrey Bell, 6 outreach entries spanning Mar 19 pitch → Mar 19/20 scheduling → Mar 27 resume email → May 5 re-engagement → May 8-11 LinkedIn rescheduling → May 13 Audrey interview confirmation for Fri May 15 10am).

Communication page made tolerant of legacy outreach shape (`at` / `direction` / `from` / `summary`) so the page renders even when old custom-shape entries are mixed with formal schema-shape entries. Was 500-erroring before. New entries from migration scripts (and the upcoming Communication composer) use the schema shape directly.
scripts/migrate-to-v2.ts — fixed a stale reference to the legacy 'Still Waiting' interview-status value (renamed to 'Awaiting Response' upstream). Typecheck stays green.

releases.title: Dashboard filter persistence actually works now (race-condition bugfix)

items.label: Fixed: filters set in the dashboard and then visiting a job's detail page were getting wiped on return. Root cause was a race condition with the search-input's debounce — on mount it scheduled a setTimeout that fired 200ms later using stale (empty) URL params from its closure, which clobbered the sessionStorage restore that had just happened. Now the debounce skips its first run and reads the live URL at fire time, so the restore sticks.

releases.title: Richer status enums — lifecycle phases, nuanced interview results, full offer-flow tracking

items.label: Application Status (+6): 'Saved for Later', 'Drafting Application', 'Pending Referral', 'On Hold', 'Withdrew Application', 'Not Looking To Apply'. Now 12 values total — covers triage (Saved for Later), in-flight (Drafting / Pending Referral), interrupted (On Hold / Withdrew), and active decisions not to pursue (Not Looking To Apply).

Interview Status (+4 lifecycle phases): 'Interview In Progress', 'Awaiting Next Steps', 'Final Round Scheduled', 'Awaiting Decision'. These pair with the existing rounds[] array — the pill captures at-a-glance phase, rounds[] captures per-round detail (which round, type, date, result, participants, notes).

Dashboard round indicator — small subtext below the Interview Status pill shows 'Round 2/4 · Technical' or 'Round 3/3 · Awaiting next steps' derived from rounds[]. Renders nothing for jobs without rounds, so the dashboard stays uncluttered.

Interview Results (+6): 'Strong Mutual Interest', 'Mixed Signals', 'Not Technical Enough', 'Too Senior for Role', 'Too Junior for Role', 'Cultural Fit Concerns'. Now 11 values total — captures the 'why' of how an interview went, especially the skill / level / cultural reasons you were asking for.

Job Status (+4): 'Negotiating Offer', 'Offer Accepted', 'Offer Declined' (by you), 'Withdrew from Process'. Distinguishes 'they didn't offer' (Not Offered Job) from 'I declined their offer' (Offer Declined), and adds explicit accepted / negotiating / withdrew states.

6 new badge colors — teal, cyan, fuchsia, zinc, emerald, lime. Light + dark mode tuned via oklch. Every new status value gets a visually distinct pill so the dashboard stays scannable even with 12 application statuses and 10 interview statuses.

Progressive visibility & audit rules updated — detail page cards reveal correctly for the new lifecycle phases; offer card now appears for any offer-adjacent status; 'Skipped' application status now enters the interview pipeline; audit rule for 'Interview Results set but no interview happened' accepts the new phases as valid; priority-underestimation audit triggers on the new milestone statuses.
Follow-up context detection — negotiation tone is now used for 'Negotiating Offer' and 'Waiting on Offer' too, not just 'Offered Position'.

releases.title: Dashboard filter state persists across navigation

items.label: Dashboard filters (application status, interview status, job status, priority, search, etc.) now persist when you navigate to a role's detail page and back, or click 'Dashboard' in the sidebar. Filter state is mirrored to sessionStorage and restored on mount when the URL is empty. Clicking 'Clear all' wipes the saved state so the next visit starts fresh. Browser back/forward still works the normal way.

releases.title: Skipped status, CORS-proof logo fetch, expand-row logo upload, same-company logo propagation

items.label: Added 'Skipped' application status — for when a recruiter or hiring team reaches out and you go straight to interview without a formal application. Distinct from 'Not Applied' (you never engaged) or 'Applied' (you submitted). Violet pill in the dashboard.

Fixed 403 / CORS errors when fetching logo URLs from LinkedIn / corporate CDNs. New /api/proxy/fetch-image route fetches images server-side with a browser-like UA + Referer; LogoUploadModal uses it instead of direct browser fetch. Verified working on media.licdn.com URLs (6.6KB JPEG returned for the LinkedIn CDAI logo URL you provided).
Logo upload action in dashboard expanded rows — 'Set company logo' / 'Replace logo' button next to 'Open full detail →' inside the expand panel.

Same-company logo propagation — uploading a logo for one job at a company automatically copies it to every other active job at the same company (using normalized company name to handle 'Compass Group (CDAI — ...)' variants). Toast confirms how many jobs got the logo. Doesn't clobber existing logos on other jobs.
Audit rule updated — 'Application Status Not Applied but Interview Status advanced' now suggests setting status to 'Skipped' rather than 'Reviewing', matching the new enum.

releases.title: Resume uniqueness, Clearbit logos + drop-image modal, inferred field badges

items.label: Resume uniqueness fix — the v1 fuzzy match attached the same source PDF to multiple jobs (5 duplicates across 9 jobs). Dedupe script keeps each PDF on its highest-confidence match; clears the rest. New 'Fuzzy match (X% confidence)' vs 'Manually assigned' badge on every resume.

Reassign resume from the source PDF picker — button on the Attachments → Resume tab opens a modal listing every resume PDF in your Job Search/ folder, with 'in use by [other job]' warnings. Picking a taken PDF moves it to the current job, removing it from the other automatically.
DocumentAssignment metadata stored per job — records method (fuzzy/manual), confidence, source filename, and assignedAt timestamp.
Clearbit Logo API as primary logo source — higher-quality, transparent PNGs for most company URLs. Falls back to Google s2 favicons, then to company-initials placeholder.

Drop-image logo modal — click any empty avatar in the dashboard (or the Logo tab on detail page) to open a modal where you can: drop a file from disk, drag an from another browser tab, paste an image URL, or click to pick. Saves to data/attachments//logo..
Source platform logos in dashboard — the 'Source' column now shows a small LinkedIn / Indeed / Greenhouse / Workday logo next to the platform name when applicable.

Inferred / assumed field badges — small amber-bordered '? assumed' / '? inferred' pill next to fields whose values weren't user-confirmed (e.g. Applied Via when same as Source, Application URL same as Job URL, priority inferred from fit+interest, initiatedBy inferred from notes). Clicking the badge marks the field confirmed and removes the badge across the app.
scripts/fix-resume-uniqueness.ts — idempotent dedupe + metadata backfill script; safe to re-run.

releases.title: Days-since bug fix, model presets, hiring-team enum, applied-via source, Offer form, logo + round file uploads

items.label: Fixed DAYS-since-applied bug — the column was showing 0d for every 'Still Waiting' job regardless of how long ago you applied. Now correctly shows today - dateApplied for every applied job.

AI model dropdowns — Settings now offers preset model lists for Anthropic (Opus 4.7 / Sonnet 4.7 / Haiku 4.7) and OpenAI (GPT-5.4 / 5.4-mini / 5.4-nano), with an 'Other... (custom)' option that drops to a text input for any model id you need.

Third initiatedBy type — 'Hiring team member outreach' for when someone from the hiring team (not a recruiter, not you applying) reaches out first. Fuchsia badge in the JobHeader to distinguish from recruiter outreach.

applicationSource + applicationUrl fields — separate from the original Source / Job URL. You can now record that you found the role on LinkedIn but applied via Workday (with the actual Workday link saved).

Full Offer form — base salary, currency, bonus, sign-on, equity, start date, deadline-to-respond, decision (Pending / Accepted / Declined / Counter), benefits notes, decision notes. Replaces the previous placeholder card. Deadline auto-syncs to the Calendar.

Company logo upload — new 'Logo' tab in the Attachments card. Upload any image (PNG / JPG / SVG / WebP); it overrides the auto-favicon everywhere (dashboard / detail page / contacts page). 'Use favicon' button reverts to the auto-fetched icon.

Per-round file attachments — each interview round now has three upload buttons (Instructions / Submission / Other) that attach files to that specific round. Files are served from /api/files/[jobId]/rounds/<filename>.

releases.title: Timeline bug fix, Settings tabs, Touch ID for API keys, Communication rename

items.label: Fixed timeline 'Found' event bug — backfilled events were using migration date instead of actual dateFound. Repaired all 55 jobs; Found now correctly precedes Applied.

Prominent 'Schedule the interview' CTA on the detail page when interviewStatus = 'Interview Set Up' and no round has a scheduled date. Amber-bordered banner with one-click date/time/type/participants/prep-notes form.

Settings split into 6 tabbed subpages with their own URLs: /settings (AI Provider + Keys) / /settings/prompts / /settings/mail / /settings/templates / /settings/thresholds / /settings/data. Tabs at top of page navigate between them.

API key 'View' button with Touch ID protection — uses WebAuthn platform authenticator (registered on first reveal). Subsequent reveals require Touch ID; key shown for 20 seconds then auto-re-masks. Forget-credential button lets you re-register. Falls back to a confirm dialog if WebAuthn isn't available.
Contacts page expandable rows — click chevron to see contact's email, LinkedIn, application status, and the full list of communications logged to them with channel/kind/date.
Contacts table now sortable on every column (Name / Role / Type / Company / Comms / Last comm).
Comms count badge per contact in the Contacts table — quick visual indicator of who you've been talking to.
'Outreach' renamed to 'Communication' everywhere user-visible — sidebar, page title, detail-page card, button labels. URL is now /communication. Internal data field stays `outreach[]` for stability.
scripts/fix-timeline-dates.ts — one-shot repair for the v2 timeline backfill bug. Idempotent.
Gmail/IMAP email auto-fetch (deferred to a future release) — would let you sync sent and received emails per contact/job into the Communication view.

releases.title: Contacts + Outreach pages, inline audit editing, AI batch-fix, 40-item pre-audit report

items.label: Contacts page (/contacts) — every contact across every job in one filterable table. Sortable, filterable by relationship (Recruiter / Hiring Manager / Interviewer / etc.) and by active-applications-only. 'Compose' button opens your mail client with the contact pre-filled.
Outreach page (/outreach) — every outreach message across every job. Filter by channel (email/linkedin/phone/text/in-person), kind, status, or 'sent but no response yet'. Each row links to its job.

Audit page now uses inline per-flag editors instead of jumping to detail — priority gets a dropdown, missing interview gets a date+time+type+participants form, missing Date Applied gets a date picker, missing contact gets a mini contact form, etc. Applying auto-confirms the field.

AI fix all button on every audit card — open the dialog, type 'what happened with this role' in plain English, AI proposes specific edits for every flagged field with before/after diffs you can edit before applying. Works for all 4 AI provider modes (Anthropic / OpenAI / Claude Code chat copy-prompt).

Pre-audit report (data/audit-report.md + collapsible panel at the top of /audit) — 40 specific, evidence-based findings across the 55 jobs. Grouped by category: skeleton rounds, status/date inconsistencies, compensation gaps, inferred fields likely wrong, stale applications, missing contacts, documents, fit-analysis gaps.
Audit list now collapsible per flag — click the row to expand into the inline editor. First flag auto-expanded.
GET /api/audit/report serves the latest markdown report for download
New scripts: `npm run audit:report` regenerates data/audit-report.md any time

releases.title: Outreach unified, 4 AI email modes, multi-contact, audit page

items.label: Outreach replaces Follow-ups — every message has channel (email / linkedin / phone / text / in-person) and kind (cold-outreach, post-application, post-round, stale-pipeline, re-engagement, negotiation, thank-you, scheduling)
Four AI email modes: Generate from scratch / Rewrite my draft / Bullets → email / Reply to received email — picked via tabs in the new outreach dialog

Multi-contact per job: Contacts card on detail page with add / edit / remove / set-primary / relationship enum (Recruiter, Hiring Manager, Interviewer, etc.). Primary contact is auto-used as default recipient for new outreach.

Manual timeline events: '+ Add event' button on the timeline lets you log application milestones (auto-confirmation received, recruiter pinged, take-home assigned, etc.) with date + milestone grouping
Configurable mail client in Settings: Gmail web (default, opens with authuser=abisgould@gmail.com), Mail.app, or Outlook web
Audit page (/audit) flags inferred / uncertain fields per job: priority, activeState, initiatedBy, missing dates, skeleton interview rounds. Click 'Mark confirmed' to clear each warning.
v2.2 migration auto-creates skeleton interview rounds for every 'Interview Set Up' job that had no round data — these surface on the audit page until you fill in the actual date/participants
Primary contact preserved: migrated into contacts[] as the first entry with isPrimary=true; outreach can reference contacts by id
AI prompt editor in Settings now includes all 5 system prompts (parse listing, follow-up, rewrite, bullets, reply) — schema extended to allow per-mode overrides

releases.title: Logos, sticky header, salary column, quick expand, AI prompt editor

items.label: Company logo column on the dashboard with auto-favicon fallback (Google s2/favicons) + per-job override field
Quick-expand row: chevron toggle reveals Why-fit, Compensation, Top-3 requirements, last timeline event without leaving the dashboard
Salary column added to the main table (uses compensation.rawText)
AI prompt editor in Settings — edit Parse Listing and Follow-Up system prompts with live rendered preview (sample listing or real job), reset-to-default per prompt
Dashboard takes full width (no max-width constraint); table is the only scrolling region — headers, stats, and filters stay pinned while you scroll the row list
Salary column is sortable by midpoint (average of min/max compensation)
Sticky table header — column headers stay frozen at the top during vertical scroll (Google-Sheets-style frozen row)
Job Tracker.app dock icon now uses the provided icon.png (multi-resolution icns built from 16x16 through 1024x1024)
Company avatar shown on detail page header next to title
Backfill migration ensures companyLogoPath defaults to null on all existing rows

releases.title: Sidebar nav, timeline, priorities, and pipeline views

items.label: Left sidebar navigation with Dashboard / Priorities / Calendar / Pipeline / Settings
Per-job timeline event log — every status change recorded with days-between-events
Priorities focus view — offers, upcoming interviews, stale apps, high-priority + draft follow-ups
Calendar month view — applied dates, scheduled interviews, follow-ups, offer deadlines
Pipeline page — per-job Gantt strips + aggregate funnel showing where the pipeline narrows
Priority field (High / Medium / Low) + Active state (Active / Inactive with reason)
Recruiter-initiated flag — distinguishes inbound recruiter outreach from self-applied jobs
Resume template tracking — record whether the Senior IC, Leadership, Balanced, or a custom resume was used
Interview round pre-screen marker (Round 0 / recruiter screen vs technical / HM rounds)
Round links — attach Google Docs, Drive folders, take-home submissions to specific rounds
Dashboard default filter hides Inactive jobs; toggle to show them when needed
v2 backfill migration reconstructs timeline from existing *LastUpdate columns + rounds + follow-ups
App icon wired as favicon (multiple sizes) and Apple touch icon

releases.title: Initial release — like-for-like xlsx replacement

items.label: Migrated 33-column Google Drive xlsx to JSON-backed Next.js app
Three-status pipeline (Application / Interview / Job) with strict dropdowns + color pills
Smart progressive visibility — interview cards hidden until relevant
Interview rounds with participants, prep/post notes, results
Follow-up drafting with Anthropic / OpenAI API or Claude Code chat copy-prompt mode
Resume + cover letter PDF upload and inline preview; Canva URL fields
Auto-attached 20 existing PDFs by fuzzy company match during initial migration
Local launch via Job Tracker.app / start.command on port 3939
